NJ deals seen 2019-2026: Clifton 2-building 55,000 SF portfolio incl. truck terminal (2019-01); Florham Park 4 Vreeland Rd 70,000 SF (2020-01); Woodland Park 16 ac JV (2021-03); Florham Park 19 Vreeland Rd 141,000 SF office/data center redeveloped to 136,714 SF industrial (2021-07); Fairfield 97 Fairfield Rd 76,560 SF small-bay (2023); Fairfield 28,000 SF on 3.4 ac from Terreno (~$8.7M); Passaic 90,000 SF w/ Millstein family office; Elmwood Park 120,000 SF portfolio w/ KRE; Elmwood Park 1 Paul Kohner Pl (2026-09). Also $25M refinancing of a legacy Wayne industrial asset (NJBIZ/MAREJ). HQ city not stated in results (deal footprint is Fairfield/Passaic County).

NJ industrial properties (340,000 sf); City National Bank $14.5M refi of 115,084 sf multi-tenant industrial in Wyckoff (JLL).
